geometry.locator: 480 m computed along geometry:lhc-tunnel-ring from ring index 1
geometry.note: Point only; not a tracing of the TI12 tunnel.
geometry.quote: FASER will be located 480 m downstream of the ATLAS IP in the unused service tunnel TI12

method: Walked 480 m along geometry:lhc-tunnel-ring (the merged OSM ring, accuracy_m 20) from the ATLAS interaction point -- taken as the middle node of LHC relation 9512017's insertion-1 segment (way 685422600), i.e. ring coordinate index 1 -- in the direction of increasing ring index (toward the Point 2/ALICE side, which OSM's own member order and insertion-2's 'ALICE' tag confirm is the '12' sector), per FASER's sourced siting '480 m downstream of the ATLAS IP in the unused service tunnel TI12' (src:colliders-lhc-faser-inspire-experiment-record). This anchors the derivation on the OSM ring (accuracy_m 20), not on the coarse campus-grade point recorded for LHC Point 1 (precision 500 m), so it does not violate the coarse-anchor rule. accuracy_m 60 m combines the ring's own accuracy with the straight-ring-arc-vs-actual-tunnel-path uncertainty; this is a single point, not a trace of the TI12 tunnel itself, since no source gives that tunnel's own path.
name: TI12 tunnel, FASER location (derived point)

summary.plain: A derived point 480 m from the ATLAS interaction point, along the LHC ring toward Point 2, marking FASER's approximate location in the TI12 tunnel.
